name: mpv
one_liner: A lightweight, no-frills video and audio player you control from the command line or your own scripts.
buyer: Hard to find a direct paying buyer — it's mostly used by power users and developers building something else on top of it.
business_use_cases: A digital signage vendor embeds it as the playback engine inside cheap kiosk or signage boxes and sells the hardware-plus-software bundle.
A home-theater installer builds and sells custom remote-control setups scripted on top of it for enthusiasts.
A video-QA tool vendor uses it headless to automate frame-accurate playback checks for a media-testing product.

money_ideas.idea: Sell preconfigured signage or kiosk boxes using it as the playback engine

steal_this: There isn't much of a standalone weekend business here — this is mature playback infrastructure. The honest play is embedding it inside something else you sell, like a kiosk box.
